summary: PASS on candidate 33188e9e (source 12dc33e), with one new Low, non-mandatory finding, F-DG5-125. The D-181 fix holds: all 12 picker screens use useAllTransformations, and with 102 (en) and 105 (ar) transformations every picker offered exactly the caller's set (missing [], extra []), and a scoped user exactly 1. The demo walkthrough picker is complete too. With 2150, 150 were missing in en and ar and there was no notice; this is latent at realistic scale and not blocking. Everything else matches round 6. Source comparison FAILS 0; integration 42 files, 527/527; root production e2e 30/30; demo e2e 12/12 (run 1's 2 ENOENT trace failures came from my own concurrent run in the same clone and are disclosed); D-182's health spec 3/3 in chromium-ar with the locale unset, cause not reproduced. Production isolation holds and the seed checksum is unchanged. No official-claim text. D-163 to D-168 and D-180 to D-182 are accepted.
